selection.provenance: PARTIAL EXPLORATORY FUSION: measured spectra projected onto parts of two upper leaves of Plant 5. Local image alignment is approximate; point-wise physical correspondence is not validated. This is not complete five-plant fusion. Native FX10 and FX17 measurements remain separate. Outside the measured white-reference columns, normalized values and indices are unavailable; raw DN remains inspectable. The dark reference and panel reflectance are unconfirmed, so valid Q/Q0 values are exploratory signals, not calibrated reflectance. Coordinates selected by frozen learned maps plus geometric and overlap-band checks; not independently surveyed correspondence.
